params.caption: 🎮 Marvel Rivals cracks down on mods and configs that give a combat edge The Marvel Rivals team has made clear that using mods or config files to gain an unfair advantage in fights is off-limits. That leaves players who tweak files to fix stuttering in a tough spot, but Guangyun Chen promises an "optimised client" to reduce stutter and performance issues. 🕒 Nov 12, 2026 · 17:26 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: PC Gamer 👍 Like if stutter is ruining your matches · 💬 Fair rule or too strict? #MarvelRivals #PCGaming #GamingNews
